## Problem and change
Explain the problem, resulting behavior, and why this approach fits.

## Related issues
Link related issues, if any.

## Validation
List commands and results. Explain skipped checks and environment limitations.

## Contributor checklist
- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/eddieir/Falcon-Automation/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and selected the appropriate target branch.
- [ ] I ran applicable tests in headless mode and recorded the results.
- [ ] I added or updated regression coverage where needed.
- [ ] I updated documentation for changed behavior, or no documentation changes are needed.
- [ ] I excluded credentials, personal data, and generated test artifacts.
